title: Breaking the Limits of Poverty and Prosperity
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he reveals the secret to creating wealth and prosperity in every area of your life. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Zehner teaches from Deuteronomy 8, showing you how to break free from the spirit of poverty and tap into the power of God's anointing to succeed. Get ready to have your mind and heart expanded as Pastor Zehner shares the truth about God's abundance and how to access it.
